items.name: all
items.title: All components
items.description: Every Clover UI component in one install.

items.name: grain-cube
items.title: Grain Cube
items.description: A grainy, isometric 3D cube rendered on the GPU with a flowing gradient on each face. Drag to spin it.

items.name: grid-reveal
items.title: Grid Reveal
items.description: A configurable grid of blocks that dissolves away to reveal content underneath, with random, wave, diagonal, and center patterns.

items.name: pin-drop
items.title: Pin Drop
items.description: A real, detailed world map that flies to any place, or the visitor's own location, and drops a bouncing pin on the exact spot.

items.name: thermal-flow
items.title: Thermal Flow
items.description: A smooth, rich thermal-gradient background rendered on the GPU. Seven themes or your own palette, no dependencies.

items.name: gauge-text
items.title: Gauge Text
items.description: An animated stat that counts up to a number next to a fixed gauge icon, e.g. "89x faster".

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A 12-dot circular loader where the dots stay fixed in place and only their color shade cycles around the ring, instead of the ring rotating.

items.name: pulse-loader
items.title: Pulse Loader
items.description: A breathing concentric-ring loader that pulses in and out on a loop, with a customizable base color, ring count, size, and speed.

items.name: rich-text
items.title: Rich Text
items.description: An inline text primitive with a rich gradient surface and configurable color treatment.

items.name: soft-button
items.title: Soft Button
items.description: A locked glossy pill button with a small set of hand-tuned color styles and sizes.

items.name: token-fall
items.title: Token Fall
items.description: Physics-based tokens that fall with gravity, bounce, and scatter away from the cursor, with a customizable spawn rate, palette, and per-token render.

items.name: candlestick-chart
items.title: Candlestick Chart
items.description: A responsive candlestick chart with drag-to-pan, wheel-to-zoom, an animated cursor, and an OHLC tooltip.

items.name: drop-text
items.title: Drop Text
items.description: Text that drops into place under gravity and settles with a bounce, word by word or character by character.

items.name: text-gif
items.title: Text GIF
items.description: Animated text filled with a GIF, creating a moving visual effect inside the letter shapes.

items.name: price-range
items.title: Price Range
items.description: A two-handle budget slider with springy handles, value labels that slide apart when they meet, and tick marks that light up inside the chosen range.

items.name: rich-progress
items.title: Rich Progress
items.description: A glossy progress bar with spring-smoothed fill, a moving sheen, a knob riding the fill edge, and an optional rough synthesized loading sound.

items.name: sign-pad
items.title: Sign Pad
items.description: A compact signature surface with pressure-aware ink, smooth drawing, undo and clear controls, animated completion, and cropped PNG/SVG exports.

items.name: apple-music-card
items.title: Apple Music Card
items.description: A track card that loads the title, artist and artwork from an Apple Music link. No API key needed.

items.name: nucleus-text
items.title: Nucleus Text
items.description: Text assembled from particles that fly inward, settle into the letterforms, and keep a subtle jitter.

items.name: cursor-tag
items.title: Cursor Tag
items.description: A sharp multiplayer-style cursor with a name tag that can face left or right and gently drift like a live collaborator.

items.name: clicky
items.title: Clicky
items.description: A 3D hand cursor that pops in on any element and presses it with a soft glow to show people where to click.

items.name: mic
items.title: Mic
items.description: A microphone button that shows a mute slash when off and a live input level from the real microphone when on.

items.name: block-text
items.title: Block Text
items.description: A colored 3D block that keeps rolling forward, bringing the next word up from the bottom as the current one tips away over the top.

items.name: logo-storm
items.title: Logo Storm
items.description: A tidy grid of company logos that pop in one by one in random order, tilt and settle, then stay with an occasional bounce.

items.name: ghost
items.title: Ghost Guide
items.description: A tiny tour guide for your design system. It floats by the cursor and reacts to every part of your UI in one word.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: A round, glossy theme button that presses like a small push switch and flips the theme instantly. It is dark in light mode and latches down light in dark mode.

items.name: rocker-switch
items.title: Rocker Switch
items.description: A black ON/OFF rocker switch that tilts in 3D. The pressed side sinks in and ON glows when it is switched on.

items.name: agent-faq
items.title: Agent FAQ
items.description: A FAQ list with editable questions. Change one and an agent loader spins while your own AI finds the answer, then writes it out word by word.
